Implemented the read-only, S3-backed live Jira Cloud multi-project rehearsal at tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/ (conftest.py + _cloud_s3_support.py + test_cloud_s3_rehearsal.py + README.md), plus a gated jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal CI job.

DESIGN (read-only, structurally enforced): only compute_snapshot (no-write inbound fetch) and bridge_preview (Mode.DRY_RUN -> persist=False) touch Jira; an autouse readonly_jira_guard monkeypatches every mutating AcliClient method to raise JiraWriteForbidden; Jira-touching scenarios assert per-project counts identical before/after. Each test builds a fresh minimal store whose ONLY remote is a throwaway s3://<bucket>/<prefix> (sync.remote, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off), deleted on teardown.

AUTHORITATIVE GREEN LIVE RUN (local, native): 7 passed in 1032.99s (0:17:12) against real Cloud projects REB + DIG over the S3 backend. Evidence: 'no-write mode, 2160 issues in snapshot' (real multi-project volume); 'RECON: outbound_differ total=0 create=0 update=0 delete=0' (ZERO Jira mutations); unknown-project REBGHOST fails closed with acli JQL 'does not exist for the field project'. All 5 validations covered: (1) one store maps REB+DIG; (2) inbound fetch pulls both at real volume w/ per-project attribution; (3) fetch+preview scoped per project, no cross-contamination; (4) S3 push/clone round-trip preserves the mapping; (5) zero Jira writes (structural guard proven non-vacuous by test_read_only_guard_is_real).

Root-caused fix vs the deleted harness (git ab9c452dd3): map ONLY real reachable projects (REB, DIG), stay read-only, and assert the true FAIL-CLOSED outcome for an unknown key instead of expecting a fetch to succeed.

CI: jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal is workflow_dispatch/schedule and gated on vars.AWS_S3_REHEARSAL_ROLE_ARN (the Bedrock CI role has no S3 perms), so the authoritative acceptance evidence is this local run; the general external job --ignores the new dir so its jira_live canary is not masked.

CLEANUP: throwaway S3 prefixes deleted by fixture teardown; verified s3://rebar-rehearsal-368f-896586841071/cloud-s3-rehearsal/ is empty. Bucket left intact (shared).
